notes.title: Ninja Blast Remake Released
notes.content:
Like Alive Hunter, Ninja Blast received a remake. The game has been completely revamped, featuring completely redone characters, scenes and scenarios.

This new Ninja Blast was released here as free update, enjoy.

notes.title: Ninja Blast Halloween Especial Event
